purpose: One connected 60-exercise practice workflow. Runtime coverage is reported separately from definitions.

separation.test_it: User-driven real GUI verification with consented isolated practice setup; incomplete exercises stay blocked.

session_plan.name: Core end-to-end Explorer acceptance
session_plan.non_repetition_rule: No exact exercise+variation repeat within a session; later sessions deliberately cover untested dimensions.
session_plan.branching: Advance only after verified pass or explicit documented skip/block; failed prerequisite blocks dependent step or routes to safe recovery.
session_plan.resume: Persist nonsecret session progress, not simulated passes.

future_sessions.focus: Alternate invocation paths, keyboard and context menus, mixed formats, small/medium/large files and multi-item operations
Boundary sizes, special filenames, nesting, conflicts, pagination, malformed files and permissions
Network failures, retry/cancellation, uncertain writes, resume, independent transfer verification and TRUE REMOTE
Remaining gaps derived from measured uncovered feature-by-variation pairs, not arbitrary repetitions

coverage_scope.discovery_rule: Derive actual supported controls and missing variants from living Legacy/Beta ledger; mark unsupported rather than claim coverage.

result_schema.absent_metric: null with explicit reason; never fabricate
result_schema.verdict_rule: Next/Skip/user report alone never earns PASSED; require observed target event and method-appropriate independent confirmation.

safety_and_privacy.delete_policy: Only delete items created within confirmed disposable test scope; verify manifest before and after.
safety_and_privacy.secrets: Never export tokens, secrets, signed URLs or unredacted private object paths.
safety_and_privacy.network_and_disk_evidence: Mark unavailable when not measured; simulated backend is not live R2 verification.
